headline: Crude Oil Prices Drop Below $115 as Middle East Peace Diplomacy Progresses
summary: Brent crude declined to $114.85 per barrel following reports of Middle East diplomatic talks involving Saudi, Turkish, and Pakistani officials in Tehran.
why: Oil benchmark movements directly impact international trade balances, transportation costs, and global inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Diplomatic initiatives reduced geopolitical risk premiums embedded in oil futures.

why_moved: Diplomatic efforts to end Middle East hostilities reduced perceived energy supply disruption risks.
